newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu says begins sample shipments of 3D chip.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu says begins sample shipments of 3D chip.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd said on Wednesday that it had begun sample shipments of the world's first three-dimensional geometry processor chip for personal computers.
The chip, called the Pinolite, can improve a computer's 3D graphics performance, a Fujitsu spokeswoman said.
The chip is priced at 3,000 yen each, she said, adding that Fujitsu hopes to sell 300,000 of the chips a month once it starts mass production in November 1997.
